messages:
sally-ae: starting POC thread for galv-35b-q4kv. need Dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS, tokenizer parity checks, and a cost estimate for a 30d trial. cc @jamal-se @rachel-soleng @kevin-sec
victor-galvanize: thanks! timeline is ~4 weeks. can you run our q4_kv variant in Dedicated? we need prefix KV caching, ability to pin model version, and disable auto-updates. also have custom tokenizer merges to validate.
jamal-se: we can run it in Dedicated. prefix caching supported for Llama-style kv layouts. need the model artifact + tokenizer files to validate quant/kv compatibility.
victor-galvanize: uploading artifact now: https://s3.galvanize/models/galv-35b-q4kv.tar.gz — tokenizer files in the tar. KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abc. data residency: us-west-2.
rachel-soleng: quick checklist for ops: 1) artifact ingest 2) tokenization parity test 3) quant layout scan 4) runtime kernel mapping 5) pricing + SOW. I'll run the tokenization test in sandbox.
deploy-bot: ingest job queued: job-id 4572. will post results here when ready.
rachel-soleng: initial tokenization diff — 2 tokens mismatch on some unicode merges (eg '→'). please re-upload merges_v2 if available.
victor-galvanize: uploading merges_v2.json now. also note we need HIPAA DPA and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
kevin-sec: kevin-sec here — we support customer-managed KMS for Private/Dedicated. HSM integrations require a partner addendum. For SOC2/HIPAA we'll coordinate with contracts. confirm that us-west-2 is the requested region.
amanda-salesops: pricing ballpark: 30d POC on Dedicated (reserved pool ~4x A100 equiv) ≈ $18k/month plus one-time setup $3k. I'll prepare a formal POC quote + SOW; annual commit would reduce unit price.
jamal-se: runtime scan notes: quant format appears to be our q4_kv adapter (fused layout). kernel config needs kv_cache_layout: 'interleaved' and a small remap for fused-blocks. snippet:```yaml
model: galv-35b-q4kv
variant: q4_kv_cache
deploy:
  mode: dedicated
  kms: customer-managed
  kv_cache_layout: interleaved
  autoscaling: disabled
```
rachel-soleng: running tokenization + ingest tests with merges_v2. ETA ~6h. if that passes we enable prefix caching and run perf/latency tests.
victor-galvanize: also blocking: our security team will drop a questionnaire. who owns that?
kevin-sec: send the questionnaire to kevin@redwood.ai or attach here. I'll coordinate. we'll need SOC2 docs, encryption in transit/in-rest details, and the network topology for the Dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: ingest job 4572 completed: tokenization PASS after merges_v2. quant scan: minor kernel remap required; artifact validated. logs: /var/log/ingest/4572.log
rachel-soleng: good news — model boots in sandbox. p95 ≈ 210ms @ batch=1 on A100-sim. enabling KV prefix cache in simulation reduced token cost ~38% on your prompt set. need to validate long-context behavior.
victor-galvanize: excellent. what are sequence length limits? we need 32k.
jamal-se: runtime supports up to 64k on Dedicated with mixed CPU-GPU KV offload. we'll provision accordingly but need to validate memory footprint with a 32k pass. rachel, can you run it?
rachel-soleng: starting 32k run now, will post numbers shortly.
amanda-salesops: I'll draft the POC SOW + quote and include the SOC2/HIPAA checklist and KMS setup steps. expect doc by EOD.
victor-galvanize: also want autoscaling disabled during POC to limit cost variability — is that possible?
jamal-se: yes — on Dedicated we can set min_nodes = max_nodes to effectively disable autoscaling. we'll apply that after provisioning.
rachel-soleng: 32k test results: p95 = 520ms, memory peak within provisioning plan. KV eviction behavior looks acceptable. one minor tokenization edge-case left — tagging victor for a tiny merges patch.
victor-galvanize: uploaded merges_v2_patch.json — very small fixes.
rachel-soleng: merging patch now, rerunning a quick smoke.
deploy-bot: smoke passed. POC environment ready. POC ID: poc-galv-3124500000
amanda-salesops: quote + SOW sent to victor@galvanize.com, cc sally-ae. includes pricing, SOC2/HIPAA checklist, and KMS instructions. please confirm receipt.
victor-galvanize: received. legal has the SOW and security questionnaire. will revert after their review.
sally-ae: thanks all — looping out for now. keep me posted on legal/security progress. :party-parrot:
